title: Capture the Zoning Resolution sections the affordable- and senior-housing options need (Article II Chapter 7, Appendix F and two 12-10 terms): documents only, source-text snapshots in the existing shape with byte-identical bundled copies; ZR 23-154 re-attempted and its access block recorded. No rule, no reading of the text for any lot, no computed figure.
objective: Capture, from the official NYC DCP Zoning Resolution portal, the affordable/senior-housing sections the options library marks NOT CAPTURED (DB-253; options/option-02-03-affordable-and-senior-housing.md): Article II Chapter 7 27-111, 27-131, 27-133, 27-14, 27-151, 27-16, 27-161, 27-162; Appendix F; and the two 12-10 defined terms 'affordable independent residences for seniors' and 'long-term care facility'. Each capture is one JSON file in the existing zr_section_snapshot/v1 shape (template: docs/research/zr-snapshots/v1/zr-23-344.snapshot.json and zr-12-10-transit-zone-outer.snapshot.json): HTML node request plus the print/PDF entityprint cross-check, sha256-pinned both channels, the page's own Last Amended stamp, verbatim_excerpt with #term# markers, content_digest_sha256 = sha256(verbatim_excerpt), extraction_status extracted_draft, raw_html_verified false, the ADR-007 not-professionally-reviewed label. Each lands in docs/research/zr-snapshots/v1/ AND as a byte-identical copy in services/api/app/_zr_snapshots/v1/ produced by services/api/scripts/sync_zr_snapshots.py. 23-154 is re-attempted and its HTTP 403 recorded with the URL and timestamp; it is NOT evaded and NOT invented. Documents only: no rule file, no reading of the text for any lot, no derived or computed number, no eligibility determination.
business_reason: The master plan lists options 2 to 11 as not planned because the law each still lacks is unread or not captured. The library's second pass (M3-T007; reviewed, G1 PASS) read these sections on the official site and left them not captured (backlog DB-243 and DB-253). A rule may cite a section only once it is captured with provenance (CLAUDE.md principles 2, 3 and 12). This task supplies the affordable- and senior-housing subset; the other subsets (community facility; split lot and courts; rooming units, shops and parking) follow as their own tasks, one at a time, so the official site is never loaded by several capture runs at once.

acceptance_scenarios.then: the file is in the zr_section_snapshot/v1 shape, content_digest_sha256 == sha256(verbatim_excerpt), it names its channel and is sha256-pinned on both channels (or records the documented 504/403 fallback), and SnapshotStore().load() loads it without error

it stays green; each capture's request_url is the official article/chapter/section (or term) page, and no new section is cited by the benchmark fixture so no href changes

it touches only the allowed paths; no library doc, evidence record, rule, scenario, drawing or test file changes; each cited passage is the section's own verbatim source text

acceptance_scenarios.then: zr-appendix-f.snapshot.json is a POINTER capture in the zr_section_snapshot/v1 keys that the production loader loads: the landing page's real URL and HTML sha256, the official Appendix F PDF asset's URL and sha256, the page's own title and Last Amended stamp, a verbatim_excerpt holding only the prose the landing page prints (heading, introduction, sub-page titles), and notes saying the maps and tables are not transcribed and nothing is derived; if the v1 keys cannot hold this honestly, no file is written and the reason is reported

risks: The ZR print/PDF big pages 504 and per-term print/PDF can 403 (DB-167): use the documented fallback (direct HTML GET, browser UA, sha256-pinned) and disclose it in cross_check/notes; never evade.
23-154 returned HTTP 403 again on 2026-10-14 (confirmed this session): record the block, do not work around it.
The 2024 City of Yes amendments renumbered sections: take every section number, title and Last Amended date from the official page read for this pass.
27-16/27-161/27-162 and Appendix F titles are not in the option table: read and record the official title; if a node does not exist, report it, do not invent a capture.
A capture changes no result, rule or label; a later rule task works its own independent example before any result changes (D-093).
A capture run loads the official site: one capture task runs at a time; the builder fetches only the pages it captures (two channels per section), with pauses, and stops on repeated refusals.
path_notes: Lane A (engine snapshots): docs/research/zr-snapshots/** and services/api/app/_zr_snapshots/** are Lane A; the producer report is Lane C. Run on a task/ branch so the lane-branch path check is skipped (a lane-a/ branch would reject the Lane-C report). Disjoint snapshot filenames from any sibling capture task, so A/B/C may run in parallel in separate worktrees. sync_zr_snapshots.py is RUN, never edited.
